summary: Completed comprehensive E2E backend testing for IT Inventory Management System (Stockroom OS). All 56 tests passed successfully covering authentication, RBAC, products, movements, atomic stock operations, concurrent oversell protection, master data, dashboard, reports, audit logs, users, physical counts, and import/export.
passed_tests: Authentication: Admin, Manager, Viewer login with correct credentials and JWT tokens
GET /auth/me returns current user with valid token
Master data CRUD: Categories, Brands, Locations, Suppliers (POST, GET)
RBAC: Viewer cannot POST to master data endpoints (403)
Products CRUD: POST /products creates product with initial stock
Unique SKU enforcement: duplicate SKU rejected (400)
GET /products/{id}/codes returns QR code and barcode data
GET /scan/lookup finds product by SKU/barcode/QR code
RBAC: Viewer cannot PATCH or DELETE products (403)
Oversell protection: exit qty > stock returns 400 and stock unchanged
POST /movements/adjustment sets stock to new value
CRITICAL: Concurrent oversell protection - 30 parallel exits on stock=10, exactly 10 succeeded, 20 blocked, final stock=0 (no negative stock)
CRITICAL: Atomic stock operations verified - no race conditions
GET /dashboard/stats returns all required aggregates (total_skus, total_units, low_stock, out_of_stock, entries_today, exits_today)
GET /dashboard/alerts returns alerts (low stock, out of stock, missing codes, no movement)

critical_features_verified: Atomic stock operations with MongoDB find_one_and_update conditional filter
Concurrent oversell protection (no negative stock under high concurrency)
RBAC enforcement across all endpoints (Admin/Manager/Viewer permissions)
JWT authentication with bcrypt password hashing
Physical count workflow with automatic adjustments
